Package com.cf.karaiskou.eshop.service

Class OrderService

java.lang.Object
com.cf.karaiskou.eshop.service.OrderService
@Service public class OrderService extends Object
Service class responsible for handling business logic related to orders.

This service manages the creation of orders from cart data, retrieval of user orders, and updating order statuses. It acts as an intermediary between controllers and repositories.

  • Method Details

    • createOrder

      public Order createOrder(Long userId, List<OrderItem> items, BigDecimal total, String shippingAddress, String shippingMethod, String paymentMethod)
      Creates a new order from cart items.

      This method converts the user's cart into an order, including all cart items. It sets the initial order status to "ACCEPTED" and stores shipping and payment details.

      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user placing the order (nullable for guests)
      items - the list of items from the cart
      total - the total cost of the order
      shippingAddress - the shipping address provided by the user
      shippingMethod - the selected shipping method
      paymentMethod - the selected payment method
      Returns:
      the saved order entity

      public List<Order> getAllOrders()

    • getOrderById

      public Order getOrderById(Long orderId)
      Retrieves a single order by its ID, including all order items.

      Typically used by administrators to view detailed information about a specific order.

      Parameters:
      orderId - the ID of the order
      Returns:
      the order entity with its items
      Throws:

    • updateOrderStatus

      public Order updateOrderStatus(Long orderId, String status)
      Updates the status of an order.

      This method allows administrators to change the order status (e.g., "PREPARING", "SHIPPED", "DELIVERED").

      Parameters:
      orderId - the ID of the order
      status - the new status to set
      Returns:
      the updated order entity
